name: Monika Fallsstrome
original_name: モニカ・フォルスストロム
source:
The manager of the "Vorpal Rabbit Inn" (首跳ね兎亭) located on Vanaheim island. She's always busy taking care of paying guests like Lyiene and Olivia.

A pleasant and gentle girl, she's eccentric and sometimes says the most outrageous things. She's also capable of spontaneous acts which catch others off guard.

[Spoiler] She's had a crush on Will ever since he moved to the island and bought a house. Although she fantasises about sex with Will, she's sporting enough to acknowledge Lyiene and Will are in a steady relationship.

She is caught by an fugitive bandit while picking herbs in the mountains. The bandit rapes Monica, but Lyiene manages to find the campsite and defeat the bandit. Monica is shaken by the experience, but quickly regains her composure and is back to her old self soon afterwards.

She says goodbye to Lyiene and Will when they depart for the mainland and hopes they come and visit her inn in the future. [/Spoiler]
